newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq composite ends higher, nears record.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq composite ends higher, nears record.

text.p: The Nasdaq composite index inched nearer to a record on Friday, extending their gains to four consecutive sessions helped by merger news, but the broader market ended mixed.
The Nasdaq Composite Index added 3.37 points, or 0.27 percent, to end unoffically at 1257.51, less than a point from its all-time closing high.
Decliners led advancers by a narrow margin. The session yielded 155 new highs and 127 new lows. Unofficial volume was about 552 million shares.
John Woczyna, market strategist at Roney & Co, said the market was seeing some skittishness after a series of four- and five-percent gains.
"Overall it was a good day," he said, adding, "What we need to see in the Nasdaq is the plurality of advancing over the declining issues pick up rather noticeably."
American Filtrona Corp rose 10-3/4 to 43-7/8 after it said it was talking with WBT Holdings LLC about WBT buying the company for $43 a share.
